records.text: 1676 1676 Resistive Touchscreen Overlay - 7" diag. 165mm x 105mm - 4 Wire If you already have a 7" TFT that is about 165mm x 105mm in size (with a visible area equal to or smaller than ~152mm x 91mm), you can put this glass resistive overlay over it to add a resistive touch screen. Adafruit Industries Electronics & Components
